system.description:
Astrologue

L’Astrologue est un utilisateur hybride de Théurgie et de Mentalisme, spécialisé dans l’observation, l’interprétation et la transmission de l’information. Son art associe étude des astres, perceptions mentales, communion, présages et communication à distance.

Dans la Terre du Milieu, il peut être savant-magicien, interprète des signes célestes ou conseiller. Un Dúnadan du Gondor peut associer astronomie et traditions númenóréennes ; un Númenóréen Noir d’Umbar utiliser les mêmes connaissances pour navigation, stratégie ou politique ; un Dorwinadan observer les cycles saisonniers et routes orientales.

Caractéristiques primordiales

Les caractéristiques primordiales sont Autodiscipline (SD), Intuition (In) et Présence (Pr). L’Intuition est la caractéristique de royaume de la Théurgie ; la Présence celle du Mentalisme ; l’Autodiscipline soutient l’observation, l’interprétation et la concentration.

Orientation technique

L’Astrologue est un hybride Théurgie / Mentalisme. Il favorise Listes de base, Vigilance, Astronomie, connaissances, Perception et Manipulation de la Puissance, Développement des Points de Puissance, Autocontrôle, Communication et Influence.

Observer le ciel et interpréter les présages

Le ciel fournit configurations, cycles et phénomènes à interpréter. Une pratique astrologique donne tendances, avertissements et moments favorables plutôt que certitudes absolues. Au Gondor, elle peut servir un conseiller ; à Umbar, un capitaine ou une maison marchande ; dans le Rhovanion, un clan ou une communauté.

La lumière des étoiles

Lumières Stellaires (Starlights) manipule la lumière et fournit certains effets offensifs. Dans la Terre du Milieu, la lumière stellaire possède une résonance particulière, surtout chez les Elfes et les Dúnedain.

Listes de sorts de base

  • Voix Lointaine (Far Voice). Communication mentale et projection de la voix.
  • Vision Sacrée (Holy Vision). Connaissance obtenue par rêves et communion spirituelle.
  • Lumières Stellaires (Starlights). Manipule la lumière et certaines attaques lumineuses.
  • Connaissance des Étoiles (Starlore). Construction et interprétation des horoscopes.
  • Perception Stellaire (Starsense). Détections mentales et modifications sensorielles.
  • Voie de la Voix (Way of the Voice). Communication, influence et certaines formes de contrôle.

Risque et observation de l’Ombre

Chercher des informations sur Dol Guldur, un serviteur du Roi-Sorcier ou Sauron peut exposer l’Astrologue. Communications et détections puissantes sont concernées par le Risque d’attirer l’Ombre.

Adaptation RMU / MERP

L’Astrologue a été reconstruit comme hybride Théurgie / Mentalisme, avec Autodiscipline, Intuition et Présence. Ses six Listes historiques restent la référence.

Cinq traditions s’appuient sur des mécaniques RMU existantes ; Lumières Stellaires (Starlights) a nécessité une intégration spécifique MERP-RMU. Les anciennes entrées erronées Startlight/Startlights sont exclues.

Astrologer

The Astrologer is a hybrid Channeling / Mentalism spell-user specializing in observation, interpretation, and the transmission of information. The Profession combines study of the heavens, mental perception, communion, omens, and communication at a distance. The movements of the sky are used to recognize favourable configurations, interpret events, and reinforce certain magical practices.

In Middle-earth, the Astrologer may be a learned magician, an interpreter of celestial signs, or an adviser versed in omens. A Dúnadan scholar of Gondor may combine astronomical observation with Númenórean traditions; a Black Númenórean of Umbar may use the same knowledge to guide an expedition; a Dorwinadan scholar may watch seasonal cycles and eastern routes; among the Elves, a related tradition may take a more contemplative form.

Prime Stats

The Astrologer’s Prime Stats are Self Discipline (SD), Intuition (In), and Presence (Pr). Intuition is the realm stat of Channeling, Presence that of Mentalism, and Self Discipline represents the patience and concentration required for observation and interpretation.

Technical Orientation

The Astrologer is a hybrid Channeling / Mentalism spell-user. Development favours Base Spell Lists, Awareness, general and magical lore, Astronomy, Power Perception, Power Manipulation, Power Point Development, Self Control, Communication, and selected Influence skills.

Observing the Heavens

The Astrologer studies the movements of stars, constellations, celestial cycles, and unusual phenomena. An Astrologer of Gondor may maintain precise tables established in Minas Tirith or Dol Amroth; a Dorwinadan scholar may compare observations made along the roads of Rhovanion; in Umbar, astronomy also has immediate practical value for sea navigation.

Astrology and Omens

Starlore helps construct and interpret horoscopes. A configuration may indicate a dangerous period, an auspicious moment, an important encounter, an approaching threat, or a coming change. Results take the form of tendencies and warnings rather than absolute certainty.

Starlight

Starlights manipulates light and provides certain offensive effects. In Middle-earth, starlight has strong symbolic resonance. Among the Elves, the association may carry a spiritual dimension; among the Dúnedain, a scholarly one; for a practitioner of Umbar, a more technical and pragmatic interpretation.

Perception and Communication

Starsense develops mental and sensory detection. Far Voice provides mental communication and projection of the voice. Way of the Voice gathers techniques of communication, influence, and certain forms of control.

Communion and Dreams

Holy Vision obtains knowledge through communion and dreams. In Middle-earth, this List often appears as a lucid dream, symbolic image, omen, or unusual feeling of certainty. A Dúnadan Astrologer may interpret such dreams within traditions inherited from the Faithful of Númenor; an Elf may understand them as a form of harmony with the Powers of Arda.

Astrologer and Seer

The Seer explores past, present, and future directly through Mentalism. The Astrologer builds practice around the heavens, omens, communion, and communication, using hybrid magic. The former excels at psychic vision; the latter combines astrology, detection, dreams, light, and communication.

Possible Profiles

Court Astrologer. Starlore, Influence, Communication, and political knowledge.

Celestial Observer. Astronomy, sciences, Perception, and Starlights.

Interpreter of Dreams. Holy Vision, spiritual lore, and analysis of omens.

Mental Messenger. Far Voice and Way of the Voice.

Military Adviser. Astrology, detection, and communication.

Base Spell Lists

The Astrologer has six Base Spell Lists:

  • Far Voice
  • Holy Vision
  • Starlights
  • Starlore
  • Starsense
  • Way of the Voice

Risk and Observation of the Shadow

Watching signs associated with Dol Guldur, mentally seeking the activities of a servant of the Witch-king, or attempting a vision linked to Sauron exposes the Astrologer to more than simple misinterpretation. Communication and detection can themselves become perceptible. Such uses remain subject to the Risk of Attracting the Shadow.

RMU / MERP Adaptation

The Astrologer is one of the Professions that had to be reconstructed more extensively for RMU. We preserve its historical identity as a hybrid Channeling / Mentalism spell-user, its three Prime Stats, and its six traditional Lists.

For the Foundry implementation, five of these traditions use Lists already available in the RMU ecosystem. Starlights required a specific MERP-RMU integration. We also preserve the dependence of certain spells upon actual starlight, a defining feature of the Profession.
